0.2.description:
Character set per mission rando:
   each mission has a character assigned. so mission 2 will always be goofy that seed, mission 3 always donald.
   Old setting is true rando where you get unlockable character items
Xion language locking: some languages start different on the option, that's now fixed.
improved mission reward detection


On the ap client side:
added debug bundle for searching bug easier
Days added to the mission location names
Melonmix now says if it's connected the first time you click the button
Mission 13 and 52 were missing chests
0.2.title: 0.2 release

0.3.description:
Fixes range extender crashing item replay(if you have the bug happen in an async or longer sync, you can dowload just melonmixAP v0.3 it should be compatibile still with v0.2 client.)

Sea salt icecream as a mcguffin. You can set the pool and required and when you get that amount xion unlocks. Mission goal still available where you have to beat 70% of mission to unlock xion.
(i don't recommend using archi's randomize option on pool and required, i haven't found the way yet to limit them, if you know ping me so you don't get random generate errors)

Starting character changed how it's handled. it's now a yaml option. Use archipelagos normal randomize option to randomize starting character

Added chest logic to some chests, should help with softlocked seeds.
Checklist also adheres to this logic so the checks wont show up if you don't have the ability to.

In general look at the options creator for the new things, also if you're using 0.3 ap world client you have to regen your seed
0.3.title: v0.3

0.4.description:
Bit more expiremental with progressive items.
They're mostly in progressive bundles. progressive gears are random from a pool but the pool size increases as you find progressive gears. the rest are set. Not married to each catagory but tried to seperate some stuff and make it more obvious what is what.

Added some more logic to hopefully smooth out the run a bit.
Xion not having keyblade should be fixed now.
Fixed some item database stuff as well.
0.4.title: V0.4
